monitor.title: Monitor
monitor.waiting_help: Numbers appear here a moment after the game starts rendering. Older engine builds do not publish them.
overlay.title: Overlay
overlay.enable: Show a small frame rate overlay on top of the game
overlay.help: Works over a game in a window or in borderless fullscreen. A game in exclusive fullscreen covers it. It does not take mouse clicks.
updates.title: Updates
updates.check_on_launch: Check for an update when the launcher starts
updates.offline: Could not reach the update server. Check your internet connection and try again.
updates.found: A new engine build is available.
updates.installed: Installed {name}. It is now the active build.
updates.no_builds: No engine build is installed yet.
updates.rollback: Go back to the previous build
updates.cleanup_ask: Keep the active build, the previous one and the newest others, {n} in all?
dev.title: Developer
dev.diag_help: The diagnostics build prints more to the log and has the in-game performance panel, and runs a little slower.
dev.own_hint: Path to a victory.exe you built
dev.profiler_help: Samples where the engine spends its time between two moments after start and writes a file. Needs the victory.pdb of the build you run, next to victory.exe, to turn the result into names.
dev.flag_added: Added to your extra flags. It applies on the next start.
dev.profile_invalid: Enter seconds for from and to (from smaller than to), a step in milliseconds and a file name.
dev.log_changed: The file has changed since it was loaded. Load it again to see the end.
dev.log_same: No new output since it was loaded.
dev.cache_help: Clearing it makes the next start translate the game's shaders again, which takes a while.
dev.env_help: The VICTORY_* values of the current or last start.
